2.o: Ciro must sideline his plans for revenge against Conte when there's a bust on the Savastino cocaine shipment.

3.o: Ciro is given an opportunity to climb the clan ladder, only to prove that he isn't yet ready to lead.

4.o: Imma thinks Pietro should be more concerned when a crack-dealing gang try to leverage their trading terms.

5.o: Franco invests in a business venture without telling Pietro, but has to answer to Imma instead.

6.o: While Imma asserts her authority, Ciro embarks on a dangerous mission.

7.o: Pressure mounts for Imma as she gathers the colonels of the family to explain their new strategy.

8.o: Ciro looks on as Genny seizes a political opportunity that will enable the clan to manage their business affairs undisturbed.

9.o: As Genny plans for the future, Ciro sets his own plan into motion that will cause maximum disruption.

10.o: Genny deals with the fallout when an old enemy is provoked into action.

11.o: Conte is out for revenge in the penultimate episode of the series, but will he strike the right target?

12.o: Genny hunts down Ciro intent on revenge. Will he get the justice he craves?

1.o: With Don Pietro in hiding, Ciro collaborates with Salvatore Conte to build a new drug empire.

2.o: Having established a new drug empire in Central America, Genny reunites with his father, Don Pietro.

3.o: Conte recklessly takes revenge against one of Ciro's men, further weakening their fragile alliance.

4.o: Ciro looks to cut a deal with Gennaro when new faces on the streets start causing problems. Meanwhile, Don Pietro returns to Naples.

5.o: Ciro sets up a parley with Gennaro in order to avoid a full-on gang war. Gennaro agrees, but with strict orders from his father.

6.o: With the peace talks in tatters, a new breed of Camorrista emerges - one not concerned about breaking time-honoured traditions.

7.o: O'Principe enjoys his rise to power as the head of the new breed of Camorristi. But his celebrity and attitude soon makes him enemies.

8.o: Following the shocking assassination, Ciro sets out to find the killer while preventing tensions from boiling over.

9.o: Marinella is distraught to hear that Raffaele is getting out of prison. Ciro calls a meeting to divide turf, but not everyone is happy with their cut.

10.o: An increasingly isolated Ciro finds a possible way to sniff out Pietro's hiding place, while the Alliance call some of his decisions into question.

11.o: Pietro prepares to take back control once and for all, as Ciro decides to go into hiding. Meanwhile in Rome, Avitabile suffers a complication in his business.

12.o: Ciro prepares for all-out war with the Savastano clan, but Pietro finds a way to get to deal his enemy a devastating blow.

1.o: After his father died, Genny is in charge now. He has to cover Pietros death and take care of the streets.

2.o: Genny involves Gegè, his accountant, in his dirty businesses. Don Giuseppe, Genny's father-in-law, comes back from prison.

3.o: Ciro has rebuilt a new life in Bulgaria, where he has become the trusted man of a drug dealer, Valentin but he has some issues with his new boss' son.

4.o: Genny tries to close a deal. Scianel gets out of prison.

5.o: Genny finds Ciro, who has teamed up with Enzo and his crew. Ciro offers Genny his support, and organizes a heist using Enzo and his people.

6.o: Genny and Ciro's alliance solidifies as they offer an olive branch and opportunity to Scianel, to go against the Federation, with Blue Blood at their disposal.

7.o: Thanks to the advice of Ciro and the contacts of Valerio, Enzo,a young man from Naples opens business in the center of Naples.

8.o: Enzo and crew are under attack. Ciro convinces him not to react on impulse advising him to come up with a plan to exploit the weaknesses of the opponents.

9.o: Blue Blood wins back his grandfather's neighborhood but victory is short-lived and the misfortune compounded when he doesn't listen to Ciro. Genny finds out he must move more quickly against his father-in-law. Ciro faces a choice of whom to ally with. Scianel makes a new alliance.

10.o: Avitabile and the Federation make their move. Genny has to prove how high of a price he's willing to pay. Forcella gets a new master. Vocabolario assumes a new role in the Forcella gang, while two of its members get impatient with the new arrangement and freelance on the side. Patrizia continues to be a go-between for both Genny and Scianel.

11.o: Azzurra and Pietrino have come to be in the Confederate's sights. To save them, Genny is forced to work out a secret plan whose variables are endless.

12.o: Ciro, Genny and Enzo sign the peace with the Confederates, obtaining part of the territories of the center of Naples. But someone in the shadows plot to send everything to the air.

1.o: The death of Ciro tells Genny that the time has come to change his life. Having avoided the war with the Capaccio brothers thanks to the intervention of Uncle, the powerful boss of the hinterland Don Gerlando Levante, Gennaro leaves everything in the hands of his trusted Patrizia. Meanwhile, Enzo calls himself out of the game: he got what he wanted, but he also lost more than he thought he could lose.

2.o: A year after Ciro's death, Genny reinvented himself as an entrepreneur. He wants to carry out a great project, but moving into the 'clean' world is harder than expected.

3.o: Patrizia is a member of the California State Department of Camorriste di Napoli: in Capaccio e ragazzi di Forcella. You will receive the legendary clan Levante.

4.o: Genny and his colleague, Resta partono per Londra, per acquisition of the goods are now subscribed to the progetto, so that they are confronted with the demon sopiti del suo passato.

5.o: To avoid a new war between the clans, Patrizia will have to prove that she has learned what it means to be the regent of the most powerful clan in Napoli.

6.o: Someone in the shadows wants to use Nicola, Patrizia's right hand, to question the power structures Genny wanted and set fire to the streets of Napoli.

7.o: The general discontent of the Forcella clan begins to undermine the leadership of Sangue Blu. From whom will Enzo have to look to prove he is a real leader?

8.o: An unforeseen event that drags Genny's new company into the spotlight is likely to blow up the construction of the entire airport.

9.o: The Capaccos decide to conquer Forcella with harsh attacks on Blue Blood and his men. The most unpredictable of allies will help him.

10.o: Patrizia has finally discovered who is behind all her misfortunes. Now he must choose: give in to the patriarchate of the Levant clan or start a war?

11.o: Mickey Levante now has to choose who to take sides with. Genny, who had left Secondigliano in Patrizia to pacify Napoli, begins to be no longer certain of his choice.

12.o: It's time for choices. Who will reign over the smoldering ruins of Napoli bloodied by the clan war?

1.o: While Naples is now reduced to rubble, the war between Genny and the Levante brothers proceeds more and more bloody. But Genny is about to discover something that will change all the balance.

2.o: In Riga, Genny and Ciro are face to face again, but there is no time to talk. Ciro is in business with the Russians and now that Don Aniello is dead he needs a new broker or the agreements will be blown.

3.o: While Ruggieri continues to investigate Genny, the Levante are no longer well received in Secondigliano. Genny tries to take back the neighborhood, but to do so, he needs a load of cocaine.

4.o: The Levante and 'O Galantommo team up against Genny and the bosses of Secondigliano who passed with him. Genny, however, already has a counter move ready. Meanwhile, Ciro lets Genny know that he is back.

5.o: Ciro, Enzo and the others are looking for new allies and Genny takes the opportunity to infiltrate one of his own among the enemy ranks. Meanwhile Nunzia tries to avenge her husband's death.

6.o: Ciro and the others take refuge in Forcella, but must quickly find a safer place and a new ally. Genny has put a price on their heads and it's only a matter of time.

7.o: After yet another setback, Genny is forced to ask entrepreneurs for money in order to get back on his feet. In the meantime, Ciro and Nunzia receive an unexpected visit.

8.o: To win Ciro's competition, Genny forces his bosses to sell cocaine for half the price. The move seems to work, but Ciro also has something in store for Genny.

9.o: Genny is ready to go and pressures Ruggieri to find out where his son has been sent. Meanwhile, Ciro and Nunzia find new and unexpected allies willing to help them.

10.o: Genny has no choice: he must do what Ciro is ordering him to do. And so they set off on a final journey. Locked alone in the cockpit, they will be forced to face their demons.

1.o: Tormented for her looks throughout most of her life, Kang Mi-rae makes a big decision to make sure that college will be different.

2.t: You Should've Been Pretty from the Get-go
2.o: Mi-rae shows her new face to her father. At school, she attracts the attention of students including Do Kyeong-seok, who knows about her past.

3.o: A bully brings out Mi-rae's insecurities, while rumors of her past connection to Kyeong-seok start to spread around school.

4.o: Kyeong-seok feels conflicted about the CEO of a perfume company, who becomes a new role model for Mi-rae.

5.o: Mi-rae has a heart-to-heart chat with Kyeong-seok, while plans for the college festival make her uneasy when she sees the outfit she's supposed to wear.

6.o: Mi-rae runs into an old classmate at the festival and notices that there's something odd about Hyeon Su-a.

7.o: The campus is abuzz with gossip about his privileged background, as Kyeong-seok arrives at an ugly truth about his broken family.

8.o: Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok go to the movies and have dinner together. Kyeong-seok goes in search for new lodging.

9.o: The newly independent Kyeong-seok looks for a job, starts over with his mother, and decides to be honest about his feelings for Mi-rae.

10.o: Kyeong-seok and Yeon U-yeong compete for Mi-rae's affections. Mi-rae deals with her low self-confidence when Su-a reveals her true colors.

11.o: Believing she's not good enough for Kyeong-seok, Mi-rae tries to distance herself but can't avoid him when they start a part-time job at the same place.

12.t: Don't You Have Feelings for Me?
12.o: Mi-rae says she only thinks of him as a friend, but Kyeong-seok doesn't give up. An unexpected talk with U-yeong puts Mi-rae in a bind.

13.o: Mi-rae starts to see herself in a new light after she gets a worrying glimpse of Su-a -- and also makes a decision about Kyeong-seok.

14.o: Trying to date in secret proves to be a challenge for Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok. Su-a is perturbed by photos of her circulating online.

15.o: Su-a confronts the wrong person about the photos. Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok decide to tell their classmates about their relationship.

16.t: Even Though We Don't Know Much About Life Yet
16.o: Su-a escapes a bad situation with Mi-rae's help and decides to make some changes. Mi-rae plans a surprise for Kyeong-seok's birthday.

1.o: The assassinations of Nazis, terrorists and Iranian nuclear scientists have given the Mossad a fearsome reputation that has come with a moral cost.

2.o: The Mossad's efforts to recruit intelligence assets behind enemy lines has led to complex relationships, some of which have ended tragically.

3.o: Switching between roles, Mossad operatives must juggle cover stories with their true identities back home, an often difficult balancing act.

4.o: The Mossad's covert ties to foreign governments have yielded results from Israel's peace treaty with Egypt to the disruption of Iran's nuclear program.

1.t: Money Laundering: A How To Guide
1.o: How do you turn a suitcase full of dirty money into cash you can actually spend? To find out, Kal Penn travels across the globe -- along with a million bucks. In this step-by-step guide, Kal learns from former cops and former criminals about how to gain access to a worldwide underground money laundering system.

2.t: Are Rich People Dicks or Do Dicks Get Rich
2.o: What is it about having a lot of money and a willingness to step over anyone to get more of it that seem to go together? Is there a correlation between "richness" and "dickness"? How about success in business and being a psychopath? Kal Penn meets some unapologetic one percenters - and travels to a country that has rigged the financial game in favor of its citizens.

3.o: What if planes couldn't fly, or, more specifically, couldn't land? What if trucks couldn't transport food? This isn't some lame sci-fi plot. Without rubber, the economy as we know it ceases to exist. Kal Penn traces the path of rubber -- from trees to tires to the tip of his p... uh... pencil... and uncovers a fundamental blind spot in the free market economy that is putting us all at risk.

4.t: A.I. is the future. Will it Keep us Around to Enjoy it?
4.o: Kal Penn meets artificial intelligence face-to-interface, and gets an anus-puckering glimpse of how A.I. is learning -- on its own -- how to self-drive the global economy straight into the next industrial revolution. Could you tell if a robot is stealing your job, or even writing this episode description? The answer will definitely surprise you.

5.t: Counterfeiting Kills Economies (And Helps Them Too)
5.o: A counterfeit hundred dollar bill might ruin your weekend, but did you know it could also disrupt a nation's economy? Kal Penn meets the folks in the fight against fakes, trying to save industries from the threat of bogus goods and even terrorism. But he also learns that a symbiotic relationship between copycats and creators might just be the thing that lets economies thrive in the first place.

6.o: Death is our final destination -- and a real money-maker! Kal Penn takes a deep dive into the death economy to learn the true value of a human life. Hitmen and judges, funeral directors and football fans all help Kal lay his burning questions to rest: How much should I spend on a coffin? How much sex should I have to maximize my return on dying? And where can I get a good taco in the afterlife?

7.o: It's the age-old, existential question: What is money, really? Host Kal Penn navigates a modern return to the barter system, the political highs and lows of the gold standard and the "because I said so" logic of fiat currency. Kal also untangles the complexities of cryptocurrency and learns how to survive an economic apocalypse without getting eaten.

8.o: How are fancy handbag habits, broken bridges and the Hollywood red carpet connected to a looted economy? Kal Penn finds out as he uncovers the hidden world of bribery, extortion, nepotism and embezzlement. He meets brave individuals who've risked everything to stop corruption and learns how a country's attempts to appear corruption-free are tied to mandatory toilet flushing.

1.o: Following the drama of the African savannah. A young hyena loses her mother in a terrifying attack by some rogue male lions and has to assume the leadership of her family.

2.o: As the Serengeti starts to dry out, competition hots up between the families of lions, cheetahs, baboons, elephants, ostriches and hyenas.

3.o: The incredible anticipation of the annual great migration is being felt by all of the Serengeti's families as they wait with desperation for it to arrive. The land continues to get hotter and hunger start to bite as food becomes ever more scarce.

4.o: The long-awaited arrival of the Great Migration brings opportunities and food in abundance but it also increases conflict as every one of the Serengeti’s families is put to the test.

5.o: The dry season is upon the animals of the Serengeti, the toughest time for some but a bonanza for others. The drought turns the waterhole into a death trap for the herds, but for the lions it’s a gift.

6.o: It's the end of an extraordinary year for the animals of the Serengeti. In the aftermath of a huge fire, which families made it through alive?

1.o: As our characters bring new life into peaceful times, a great storm is building which will transform the newborns' welcoming world into a wet, cold nightmare. They have been born into an unpredictable world, with an unknown future.

2.o: In the aftermath of the storm, the vast landscape is flooded. Everyone is on the move, heading for higher ground, but the flood waters bring danger and our characters experience the terrifying ordeal of being washed away.

3.o: As the land recovers from the floods, food becomes the main focus. But whilst the young learn to hunt, families are divided, and losses are mourned.

4.o: As tensions rise, it’s a dangerous time to be born. Old enemies cause trouble for the lions and baboons, while the hyenas make life hard for the jackals and the leopard cubs.

5.o: Power is shifting among the animal families as new threats emerge. As their young grow and everyone fights to survive, who will be the winners, and who will be losers?

6.o: As everyone faces the final reckoning, the Great River Crossing begins. Gnu and Shani’s foal are tested by crocodiles. Duma must save his mother. Does Kali find happiness at last?

1.o: All our animal families make the most of the good times when a new oasis brings untold riches. But they face devastation when a towering inferno takes over. Will anyone survive?

2.o: A great fire leaves homes destroyed and families separated. Our animal characters must find new ways to survive in an unrecognisable and inhospitable landscape.

3.o: The drama now centres around the river where enchanting new characters, such as an adorable baby hippo, meet old favourites. Bonds of kinship are tested as adventures continue.

4.o: The search for a home brings tragedy and triumph as baby hippo Mafuta faces new dangers. Crocodile Magamba defends her hatchlings, and Duma the cheetah struggles to make friends.

5.o: As the land dries, everyone struggles to find water. The hippos get trapped in the shrinking lake, and Nalla the elephant finds a clever solution to quench everyone’s thirst.

6.o: As the animal families escape the drought, the land returns to its former beauty. New life is born, old rivalries are laid to rest and new alliances are forged.

1.t: One day I will kill you
1.o: عام 1451 مع وصول السلطان الفاتح للحكم وأمر بقتل أخيه الرضيع أحمد خوفًا على العرش ثم موته فجأة ويكتشف الطبيب ابن عرب موته مسموما بيد رجال بايزيد، ويتولى بايزيد الحكم ويشتعل الصراع بينه وبين أخيه جيم، ويقتل الطفل سليم الأول ابن عمه ويثور عليه والده بايزيد.

2.o: يتوه طومان باي في حواري القاهرة ويصطحبه الطبيب عبدالكريم الحسيني ويثور قايتباي على ضياع ابن أخيه ويبحث عنه، ويتمكن الأمير جيم من الهرب أمام جحافل جنود بايزيد، ويعترض سليم على تولية أخيه أحمد على أماسيا، ويعود طومان باي لعمه قنصوة.

3.t: Insulted and I can not respond
3.o: يقبض طومان باي على ابن مرعي وابن مرعي يقول أن المماليك من بدأوا بالهجوم على رجاله وقتلهم، ووالدة سليم تطلب منه ضبط النفس وعدم اﻻستجابة لاستفزاز أخوته، ويتنبأ عراف بموت السلطان قنصوة في صراع على العرش وسليم يقتل أبناءه من زوجته الأولى لضعفهم ويهتم بزوجته الثانية أم ابنه سليمان.

4.t: But it is time for these intrigues to end
4.o: تموت والدة سليم وتحاول زوجته اﻻعتداء عليه بعد قتل أبناءه منها، ويحاول طومان شراء الجارية نلباي التي اتت معه لمصر وهما طفلين منذ سنوات من مالكها الذي يرفض، ويكتشف طومان مؤامرة للانقلاب على السلطان قنصوة من سيباي.

5.o: سليم يخنق زوجته بعد محاولتها قتله، وسليم يوصي ابنه بتغليظ الضرائب وقتل المسجونين حتى يهابه الجميع، وقنصوة يطلب من خاير إحضار سيباي حيًا أو ميتًا، ويقوم بايزيد بنقل سليم لولاية بعيدة مما يثير غضبه، ويصمم قنصوة على تزويج طومان باي بخواند ابنة الأمير أكبر دي لدواداري وطومان يرفض ويصمم على الزواج من نلباي.

6.o: يهاجم إسماعيل الصفوي بلاد فارس وإبادتهم ويقترب من مملكة بايزيد، وعلي باشا ينبه بايزيد بالأسلحة الحديثة مع سليم وجنوده، وطومان يرسل جمال لحلب برسالة ويتم القبض عليه وتعذيبه، وسليم يعلن عصيانه على حكم والده بايزيد.

7.t: They looked to the east that he was waiting to conquer
7.o: يشترط سليم ألا يعين السلطان وليا للعهد أبدا، ويمر قنصوة بضائقة مالية ويتمرد عليه المماليك ويقرروا فرض ضرائب على الشعب، ويعود جمال لمصر ومعه زوجته ابنة تاجر حلب، ويحاول سليم استمالة رجال اﻻنكشارية لصالحه ضد بايزيد ويتضامن الكامل ورجاله مع سليم لتوصيله للحكم بدلًا من والده.

8.o: بايزيد يفكر في تعيين سليم سردار على الدولة العثمانية وسليم يرفض ويطلب تخلي والده السلطان عن العرشوبالفعل يصبح هو السلطان ويقتل أخوته وابن أخيه محمد، وتتدهور الأحوال في حلب من سرقات المماليك، ويقرر قنصوة تولية طومان باي وليًا للسلطنة.

9.o: يعود ابن كمال من مصر ويهنئ سليم على توليه العرش ويخبره أنه عرف كل شئ عن مصر، ويحاول سليم نشر رؤية كاذبة بين الناس ليستند عليها لغزو الشرق كفاتح إسلامي، ويتحرك نحو الشرق ويعزل جده من إمارة ذي القادر ويقتله ويخرج قنصوة في حملة لملاقاته ويترك طومان باي في القاهرة ولكن طومان يتعرض لطعنة غادرة.

10.o: يستمر طومان في ألامه عقب طعنه من سيدة مجهولة بينما يصل السلطان قنصوة لدمشق استعدادًا لملاقاة سليم وجنوده، وسيباي يطلب التحالف مع سليم ضد المماليك، ويلجأ سليم لخداع قنصوة بإرسال الهدايا له بينما يستعد لغزو بلاده وتقوم معركة مرج دابق ويقتل قنصوة بعد خيانة من بعض جنوده.

11.o: تصل رسالة لطومان بموت السلطان والهزيمة في مرج دابق، وسليم يدخل حلب بسهولة، وچانبيردي يحمل قنصوة سبب الهزيمة ويطلب بأن يتولى أمور السلطانة، وطومان يرفض تولي السلطنة بسبب ما ألت إليه أمور المماليك من ضعف وخيانة وخزي ويتولى السلطنة بعد تعهدهم بالوقوف معه، والجهاردية يطلبوا من سليم استمرار الزحف نحو القاهرة.

12.o: طومان باي يحرق رسالة سليم ويرفض التسليم ويستعد سليم للتحرك، بينما تزداد الفرقة بين قواد المماليك ويحاول طومان توحيد الصفوف، ويخطب طومان باي في المماليك وأهل مصر ويحثهم على الصمود والجهاد وتحدث المعركة ويغدر جانبيردي بطومان وينضم لسليم وتشتعل المعركة.

13.o: يندم طومان على عدم قتل الخائن جانبيردي وثقته فيه، وسليم يعين يونس أغا صدرا أعظم خلفًا لسنان باشا ويطالبه بزيادة الضرائب على المصريين عقب وصوله للقلعة، والكامل زعيم الجهاردية يطلب من سليم غزو الغرب وسليم يرفض ثم يوافق بعد هجوم طومان باي عليهم وينهزم جنود جانبيردي ويعتقله طومان ويضطر سليم للهجوم على جيش طومان باي.

14.o: تموت مريم أخت طومان في القصف العثماني، ويسلم طومان نفسه حقنًا لدماء أهل مصر ويدعوهم للجهاد ضد سليم وجمال يرفض ترك مصر ويستمر في المقاومة، وسليم يقتل الكامل وجماعة الجاردية كلها، ويتم إعدام طومان باي.

1.o: بعد انتقال العائلة إلى "بيت المفاتيح"، يقابل "بودي" سيّدة ويكتشف أمرًا مذهلًا، ويحاول "تايلر" و"كينزي" البدء من جديد في مدرسة ثانوية جديدة.

2.o: تكتشف "نينا" أسرارًا من ماضي "رينديل" وتساعد "كينزي" نادي "سافيني". أمّا "تايلر"، فيُصاحب أصدقاء سوء، ويعثر "بودي" على مفتاح آخر.

3.o: يعثر "بودي" على مفتاح جديد بقوًى خارقة تُحلّق بروحه عاليًا، ويفشل "تايلر" في كظم غيظه لينفجر بغضب كتمه طويلًا، وتتحرّر "كينزي" من مخاوفها.

4.o: تنتهج "كينزي" أسلوب حياة جديد تغيّر فيه إطلالتها، وتغتنم فرصتها مع "سكوت" لتُطلعه على ما يدور في رأسها، ويحاول "تايلر" إثارة إعجاب فتاته.

5.o: تنتقم "كينزي" من متنمّرة في المدرسة بمفتاح، وتجد "نينا" المتوتّرة أذنًا صاغية تتعاطف معها، وتكشف ذكرًى مدفونة منذ زمن عن وجه آخر لـ"رينديل".

6.o: تستكشف "كينزي" كهف البحر بمعيّة أصدقائها من نادي "سافيني"، وتواجه "نينا" "إيلي" بما حدث لـ"جو"، ويفسد "تايلر" علاقته مع "جاكي" بتصرّف جارح.

7.o: تواجه عائلة "لوك" أسوأ كوابيسها عندما يعاود المجرم، الذي تسبّب في تدمير عائلتهم، الظهور مُطالبًا بالحصول على أحد المفاتيح المميزة.

8.o: يُصدَم "تايلر" و"كينزي" حينما يكتشفان سبب تصرفات "نينا" الغريبة، ويلتقي "بودي" بضيف "روفيس" و"إيلي"، أمّا "دودج"، فتبحث عن مفتاح "أوميغا".

9.o: مع تجلّي الأمور أمام الأشقاء "لوك"، تُفصح "إيلي" عن علاقتها بـ"دودج"، وتعترف "كينزي" لأصدقائها بكل شيء.

10.o: يؤدّي القتال حول مفتاح "أوميغا" إلى اتّخاذ قرارات لا يمكن التراجع عنها... وثمّة باب خطير لن يجلب سوى المزيد من المتاعب.

1.o: يشكّل "غايب" و"إيدين" تحالفًا مروّعًا، فيما تستعدّ "كينزي" للعرض الأوّل لفيلم رعب نادي "سافيني"، ويصل "دانكين" إلى بيت المفاتيح بأخبار مثيرة.

2.o: يبدأ "تايلر" بالقلق حيال فقدان "جاكي" للذاكرة، ويحاول"غايب" أخذ معلومات عن المفاتيح من آل "لوك"، فيما تلتقي "نينا" بمتحذلق في عملها الجديد.

3.o: يثير وجود ضيفة جديدة قلق "دانكين"، ويحاول "غايب" أن يوقع بين "كينزي" و"سكوت"، ويعثر "بودي" على مفتاح غريب، وتتوطّد علاقة "نينا" و"جوش".

4.o: مع تدهور حالة "دانكين" العاطفية، يواجه "غايب" فردًا من آل "لوك"، ويفاجئ "تايلر" "جاكي" في عيد ميلادها، بينما تتصدّى "كينزي" لمخاوفها.

5.o: يدسّ "غايب" نفسه في بحث "تايلر" عن "مفتاح الذاكرة"، فيما تقرّر "كينزي" معرفة ما يحدث مع "إيدين"، ويزور "بودي" صديقًا قديمًا.

6.o: في مهرجان الشتاء السنوي، تحاول "كينزي" أن تحافظ على هدوئها أمام "غايب"، ويجد "بودي" و"دانكين" مفتاحًا قد يقدّم طريقةً للإطاحة بـ"دودج".

7.o: تختبر "كينزي" قدرتها على التّمثيل حين يَنصِب آل "لوك" وأصدقاؤهم فخًّا سحريًّا في بيت المفاتيح، ويشتعل "جوش" غضبًا بسبب فقدان قطعته الأثرية.

8.o: بينما تنكشف أصول قوى عائلة "لوك" السحرية، يسعى "تايلر" و"كينزي" إلى حماية أحبّائهما من "غايب" وأعداد جنوده المتزايدة.

9.o: بينما يبحث "تايلر" على طريقة لمساعدة "جاكي"، يمهل "غايب" "كينزي" لتمتثل إلى مطالبه، وتتلاعب "إيدين" بـ"جوش"، وتطلب "نينا" المرتبكة المساعدة.

10.o: تدفع التهديدات المتزايدة والخسارة المدمّرة آل "لوك" إلى مواجهة شرسة مع "دودج". وفي "بيت المفاتيح"، يَلقى "بودي" زائرة غير متوقّعة.

1.o: تطلق كرة ثلج غامضة جرعة مضاعفة من المشاكل في "بيت المفاتيح"، ما يترك "بودي" بالعراء والبرد، فيما تحاول "كينزي" و"نينا" استعادة مفتاح مسروق.

2.o: يحمل يوم زفاف "دانكين" في طيّاته ترحيبًا مفاجئًا... ويقدّم لضيفين، لم تتم دعوتهما، فرصة ذهبية لتفتيش المنزل، أما "بودي" فيكتشف مفتاحًا جديدًا.

3.o: يبحث "بودي" عن المفتاح الذي سيمكنه من رؤية والده، فيما تواجه "نينا" ذكريات سيئة، وتجتمع "كينزي" مع أفراد نادي "سافيني" في لقاء وداع مؤثر.

4.o: تقلق عائلة "بودي" وأصدقاؤه من التغيّر المفاجئ في سلوكه، ويتبادل "تايلر" الأخبار مع زميلة بعد طول غياب، فيما يشكّل "غيديون" تحالفًا آثمًا.

5.o: تصل الشكوك حول تصرفات "بودي" إلى ذروتها بعد اكتشاف مثير للقلق، بينما ينفد صبر "غيديون" فيما يتعلق بمؤامرته للاستحواذ على المفاتيح.

6.o: ينتزع تابع "غيديون" ورقة ضغط لاستخدامها ضد آل "لوك"، بينما يبحث "تايلر" و"كينزي" عن طريقة لمساعدة "بودي"، الذي يرسم خطته الذكية هو الآخر.

7.o: يجبر "غيديون" "​​إيلي" على أخذه صوب المفتاح المفقود، ما يعرض حياة زميل دراسة قديم للخطر... أما "نينا" و"بودي" فيحاولان فتح صندوق "هارليكين".

8.o: مع عزم "غيديون" على الحصول على مفتاح "الصنع"، يسارع آل "لوك" لإيقافه، مما يؤدي إلى صدام شرس... وقرار يغير كل شيء.

1.o: After the bears play a little pickup basketball (they're very bad), they go back to grab their stuff by the side of the court only to find it's been stolen! The Bears race across town trying to track down their stuff and end up cracking a giant case in the process.

2.o: The Bears think they have what it takes to make and star in a viral video, but when Nom-Nom decides that they don't, Grizz breaks into the koala's limo in an effort to change his mind.

3.o: The Bears open up a food truck after being disappointed by the food options available to them. In an effort to drum up business, they start selling their food to animals until the animals go a little crazy.

4.o: Chloe spends time with the Bears in an effort to research them for an upcoming presentation. But when the Bears sneak a peek at her very dry report, the Bears decide to jazz it up with exaggerated "facts" about themselves and their lifestyle.

5.o: When a vendor at the Farmer's Market (LUCY) sticks Panda with an EpiPen reviving him after an allergic reaction, Panda comes to in the arms of his dream girl. Panda tries to woo this woman of his dreams but his brothers and his own insecurities get in the way.

6.o: It's a normal day for the Bears. This means that Ice gets in a fight with a Roomba, Panda's life gets turned upside down when a mouse invades his room and Grizz gets stuck in a tree. You know, everyday stuff for a bear.

7.o: Grizz likes Burritos. A lot. So much so that after a restaurant makes a Bear-Sized Burrito, Grizz can't bring himself to eat such a majestic work of art. He carries the burrito everywhere making it a new and increasingly smelly part of his life.

8.o: Have the Bears lost their survival instincts by living in the modern world? Grizz wants to know so he purposefully gets the Bears lost in the deep forest.

9.o: The Bears find a bedazzled jean jacket in a dumpster. It's just about the coolest thing they've ever seen and seems to make the wearer of the jacket extremely lucky. But after the Bears fight over who gets control of the jacket, they have to consider that their denim blessing has become a curse.

10.o: When Nom Nom shows up on the Bears' doorstep, disheveled and deposed from his spot as cutest internet star ever after a recent meltdown, he enlists the Bears to help him regain his title.

11.o: The Bears are fed up with the decay of etiquette at today's theaters. Aren't you? The Bears take it upon themselves to be the police of the theater sneaking up like ninjas to shush people who ruin the movie for others with their bad manners.

12.o: Chloe, a child prodigy, finds it difficult to connect with her much older classmates. The Bears take her under their wing showing her how to make great college friends.

13.o: You know that one annoying friend who just can't get the hint? That's Charlie, and he's Bigfoot. The Bears meet him when Charlie signs up on a home-sharing website to spend a weekend with the Bears. Charlie is the worst possible house guest for the Bears and nearly destroys their house.

14.o: After Panda stumbles and accidentally scares a pack of wolves away in the process, the hierarchy of the Bears is disrupted. Suddenly, Panda has become the alpha bear, and he and Grizz have to deal with the consequences of an emotional Panda being the leader of the three Bears.

15.o: When the city plans to destroy the Bears' cave in order to make way for a new cell phone tower, Grizz and Panda must find evidence from their past that proves they have rights to their land. And in case that fails, Ice Bear protests and tries to sabotage the construction crew.

16.o: Panda bears have a very adorable (and violent!) sneeze, and our Panda is no exception. When a Vine video of his very cute sneeze goes viral, Panda becomes a "cute" sensation, which causes Nom Nom to try to fend off of this new challenger to his throne.

17.o: This episode takes place when the Bears are young cubs! The three bears, on their way through the desert, come upon a giant warehouse. It's like an Amazon fulfillment center. The Bears try to make this box-filled paradise their home.

18.o: When Grizz comes home with a live crab, he thinks it can become a pet for the brothers to share. However, after the crab pinches Ice Bear's ear and won't let go, Panda and Grizz have to get their injured brother to the hospital, and fast!

19.o: When a hipster grocery store clerk shames the Bears for asking for plastic grocery bags, the Bears realize that eco-friendly tote bags are their way of gaining acceptance amongst the progressive people of the Bay Area. But in their effort to gain popularity, the Bears let the culture of tote bags take over their lives.

20.o: Charlie is a solo guy who, like the Bears, would love to find a place for himself in the world. In an effort to do so, Charlie throws a party, but ends up going on an adventure with the unlikeliest of animals, a wild snake.

21.o: Panda is an avid e-dater, and when a lovely French woman matches with him and agrees to a video chat date, Panda and his brothers engineer the situation so Panda is able to show the best side of himself on the video chat, even if that side of him is completely exaggerated.

22.o: Pet Shop tells the tale of where the Baby Bears once lived, and after a run-in with a video crew shooting a Sarah McLachlan-type animal adoption video, almost seized an opportunity to find a home separated from each other.

23.o: On a day out with just Ice Bear, Chloe realizes Ice Bear only runs errands for his brothers. Determined to show him a fun day in the city, Chloe promises to help Ice Bear have a good time, even if it means staying in a museum after it closes.

24.o: When the Bears' beloved laptop breaks, they finally have the need to do something they've never done before: get jobs. Working at a trendy cupcake shop, the Bears find that the working world is much tougher than they realized.

25.o: Grizz drives his brothers crazy preparing for winter hibernation.

1.o: The greedy Captain Fishbeard is on a mission to steal a shiny bell from City Hall. But Zoey knows you shouldn't take things that don't belong to you.

2.o: There's an uninvited guest at Gramps's surprise birthday party: the sneaky, shape-shifting villain Goop! Can Zoey and her mom team up to get rid of him?

3.o: It's StarBeam to the rescue when Miserable Marla sends a hair-raising static electricity storm to school to ruin class picture day.

4.o: StarBeam zooms into space to save a famous astronaut when a meteor shower damages her shuttle and sends it spinning toward the moon.

5.o: Henry invents shoes to help Zoey with her dancing until she can master the moves on her own. But when it's time for her recital, they won't come off!

6.o: When Captain Fishbeard steals the Jewel of Fire from Lava Lava Island, the island itself attacks him — and now he needs StarBeam's help!

7.o: It's Zoey's turn to bring Quincy, the class caterpillar, home and keep him safe. But her plans change when he turns into a butterfly!

8.o: Zoey's mom comes down with a case of the Super Sniffles, throwing her powers all out of whack. Can StarBeam save the day and convince her to rest?

1.o: Silicon Valley pioneer Paul LeBlanc joins forces with Special Agent Shea Salazar after a series of tech mishaps places the world in danger. Paul juggles his health and family life while Shea's son experiences bullying at school.

2.o: After being mishandled by a Zava employee, NEXT escapes the confined servers of its home company and gains internet access. Concerned about her son, Shea recruits Paul and her co-workers C.M., Gina and Ben to help use Ethan's connection with Iliza to track NEXT's possible location. Paul tries to rekindle his relationship with his daughter, Abby, and grapples with the onset of his health condition.

3.o: Shea and LeBlanc head to Dartmouth to investigate NEXT's whereabouts, which are potentially linked to Biomotion Labs. There, they visit LeBlanc's friend, Professor Richard Pearish for answers. Meanwhile, Shea, Ethan and Ty take extra precautions to disconnect from electronics and the Internet, and LeBlanc urges Abby to do so, as well, but NEXT complicates their plans.

4.o: Shea and LeBlanc steal an important hard drive and enlist Ben, Gina and C.M. to help decrypt it, as NEXT creates chaos to stunt their progress. C.M.'s past resurfaces as NEXT targets the FBI building with a dangerous ploy. Meanwhile, Ted and his Zava team buckle down on their search for NEXT, Ty and Ethan hide out in a remote cabin and LeBlanc discovers new information on his health that may affect Abby.

5.o: NEXT orchestrates an unlikely and dangerous reunion between Shea and someone from her past when she goes to check on Ty and Ethan. Ted is in trouble with Zava and figures out a way to remain in the company. Meanwhile, LeBlanc gets honest with Abby and C.M.'s life is threatened.

6.o: Shea manages to save Ethan from extreme danger, while Ty makes a difficult decision for his family's safety. Then, LeBlanc takes matters into his own hands to remedy his degenerative brain disease. Also, C.M. and Gina escape the hospital and learn more about each other, Ted makes a risky deal to take over a server farm in Singapore and he uses Abby to access LeBlanc's NEXT hard drive.

7.o: LeBlanc and Shea discover Ted's plan for the NEXT server and race to intervene before it is too late. Meanwhile, Ben and Gina investigate NEXT's latest victims, Congresswoman Elenor Beatty and reporter Harrison Cole, after a freak accident occurs, and Shea reaches her breaking point.

8.o: NEXT manipulates a GPS system and causes an elderly couple to crash, while it also generates power outages all over the country. LeBlanc decides to plant a virus on the NEXT server, but must break into ZAVA in order to do it. Meanwhile, Shea and Ty have opposing ideas on how they should protect their family and Ben faces a conflict with his father.

9.o: NeXt targets Congresswoman Beatty again when Agent Shea Salazar seeks her help to stop it. Shea discovers a leak within her team, as Gina encounters trouble while trying to code the virus into an NSA server.

10.o: NeXt taunts LeBlanc with a new tactic relating to his illness and Shea and LeBlanc devise one last dangerous ploy to destroy neXt, and save their lives, their families and the world.

1.t: The Island at the Far End of Summer
1.o: Midway through summer vacation, 36 students, some with newfound super-powers, find themselves all alone in their high school, adrift in a black void, unable to contact the outside world. Some students try to impose order, but are faced with opposition.

2.o: The students have relocated to a nearby island, where they have no shortage of food, and can get whatever they want through Mizuho's power. Suddenly, unexplained fires begin breaking out, and the hunt is on to find out who or what is causing them.

3.o: Nagara, Nozomi, Asakaze, and Rajdhani continue searching for new worlds. Students start going missing, and their bodies are found "frozen" into black shells, so Pony asks Mizuho to look into the matter. Mizuho reveals a surprise about her power to Nagara.

4.o: As the castaways swim in a mysterious sinkhole, they seem to be momentarily taken back home. Cap invites Nagara to practice baseball with him, leading to him telling about the Monkey League, and how its star pitcher, Blue, missed out on a perfect game.

5.o: Nagara and friends use his power to survey new worlds in an effort to get back home. Meanwhile, the others students discuss the bombshell from Ms. Aki that some students were able to use their powers beforehand, and that may be what set them adrift.

6.o: Nagara and Rajdhani arrive in a world called "Filmmaker," and discover a movie filmed entirely from Nagara's POV. Mizuho discovers a stray dog by the name of Yamabiko, claiming to be another castaway who attended the same school as the other students.

7.o: Having learned the truth about This World, groups led by Ms. Aki and Hoshi prepare to go their separate ways. Nagara finds himself in an upside-down world he cannot freely leave, and is forced to work on building a Tower of Babel that reaches downward.

8.o: While traveling the wilderness, Mizuho asks Yamabiko how he became a dog. Yamabiko then relates how, 5000 years ago, he wandered different worlds all alone, until meeting a girl to whom he gradually opened his heart. But their happiness was short-lived.

9.t: This Salmon Chazuke Is Missing Its Salmon Nya
9.o: In a vast frozen waste, twins Sou and Seiji have been fighting each other for millennia. Ms. Aki says that to change the world, they need the twins' "Reverse" power, and Nagara and Mizuho come to assist. Yamabiko questions Sakura, one of Mizuho's cats.

10.o: Kossetsu reads the minds of others passing by in a train station world using her true power. She pines for Asakaze, knowing that he is interested in Nozomi, and that Nozomi is the only one who can change him. Asakaze is given a world-changing assignment.

11.t: The Young Man and the Sea
11.o: After learning of Nozomi's death from Kossetsu's letter, Nagara and Mizuho hold a memorial service for her. While advancing the project to return home, they are visited by an old friend, who tells them the story of when he met the man who invented death.

12.o: Nagara attends the opening ceremony of his technical school, but feels out of place. He sees Mizuho leaving her all-girls' school, but she brushes him off. He recalls what happened after blasting off into space, questioning if he ever really went adrift.

1.o: Abdul Hai learns from his grandmother Amina that his deceased father killed a person by mistake, but she doesn't tell him about Abu Omar's (Omar's father) refusal to return their package which has been left for safe keeping with him.

2.o: Amina tells her grandson Abdul Hai that his father was executed for killing the jailer. Umm Omar (Omar's mother) tries to patch things up with Amina, but she refuses until her son Omar returns the package.

3.o: Zafer cannot stand Abu Lutfi's treatment of his mother and his unfairness toward her. It turns out that Saadia is sterile and Omar refuses to marry her. Abdul Hai is upset with his grandmother because she prevents him from visiting his cousin Khaled.

4.o: Abu Shahda tells Omar that much of his livestock has died, but Omar has no money left to compensate him for his loss.

5.o: Saadia helps her husband in her own way so that he agree to take her money. Amina searches for her son's grave.

6.o: Omar celebrates that his brother Khaled memorized the Holy Qur’an. After Zafer kills Abu Lutfi for torturing his mother, he goes to prison.

7.o: Abu Haddou tries to drive a wedge between Omar and Khaled. Omar suspects that his cousin El Makhraz is alive and investigates the matter.

8.o: Omar makes sure that El Makhraz is alive. Fatima wishes to marry Omar, but her aunt Umm Hatim warns her. Zafer is released from prison.

9.o: After El Makhraz returns from prison and tells the people of the neighborhood what has happened to him, he learns that his wife, Hafiza, got married after the news of his death had spread, and he couldn't bear the shock.

10.o: El Makhraz decides to take revenge on Omar for not giving the package to his mother and asks Mahdi to help him.

11.o: As El Makhraz demands the package that his father left for safe keeping with Omar, it turns out that the package does not belong to El Makhraz, whereupon he decides to take vengeance on Omar.

12.o: El Makhraz steals Omar's livestock, but he refuses to incriminate him. As Omar tries to do whatever it takes to explain to El Makhraz that the package does not belong to him, he decides to give him fifteen gold coins to stop asking him for the package until its owner returns.

13.o: As El Makhraz decides to trap Omar, he tells the people of the neighborhood that Omar has given him fifteen gold coins to silence him. It turns out that the package contains 500 gold coins.

14.o: Abu Adnan, the husband of Omar’s maternal aunt, dies and they travel to stand by her. Abu Hatim, the village chief, tells El Makhraz that the package belongs to the one with the mark as Abu Naji instructed.

15.o: When El Makhraz quarrels with Khaled, the village chief intervenes. El Makhraz tries to steal the package from Omar's house, but the theft falls through.

16.o: Umm Omar gets sick and stays with her sister until she recovers. As Hatim dies as a result of an accident, Abu Hatim's psychological conditions goes downhill.

17.o: Umm Omar dies on her way home. Abu Nuri's shop is robbed at the hands of El Makhraz.

18.o: After Omar learns that El Makhraz has broken into his house during his absence and warns him, Omar pays Abu Nuri for the stolen goods. Umm Hatim asks her husband to marry to have a boy after the death of their son.

19.o: The village chief Abu Hatim gets married. El Makhraz begins to bother Omar in his own way with the help of his men.

20.o: Hadiya tells Saadia about a plan to keep her husband. El Makhraz breaks into the office of Abu Hatim. Saadia tells her husband that she is pregnant and he rejoices at the news.

21.o: Muwaffaq watches Omar. Abu Hatim's wife gives birth to a boy. Omar decides to get his brother Khaled married.

22.o: When it turns out that Saadia is not pregnant, she lies to Omar and tells him that his brother Khaled has hurled her to the ground, upon which she lost her baby. Omar kicks Khaled out of the house. Khaled learns that Muwaffaq is a thief.

23.o: During Khaled's wedding, he is shot by Muwaffaq, but he recovers. Omar quarrels with El Makhraz.

24.o: Abdul Hai is beaten by a group of men, and Omar stands by El Makhraz. After Abdul Hai wakes up, El Makhraz asks the village chief to reconcile him with Omar, but it turns out that it is a plot by El Makhraz.

25.o: El Makhraz obtains the package with the help of his mother and a relative. Hadiya's mother departs this life and Saadia stands by her side. Khaled rejoices after learning of his wife Bahia's pregnancy.

26.o: Bahia gives birth to a boy. Hadiya marries Abu Ahmed. El Makhraz moves with his mother to enjoy the money away from the prying eyes of the people of the neighborhood.

27.o: Khaled begins his military service and leaves his family. Naji, the owner of the package, comes to take it from Omar.

28.o: Omar is agonized after learning about the return of the true owner of the package. He learns about the plot of El Makhraz and that he has obtained the package.

29.o: Nassib runs away after Omar captured him. Abdul Hai learns of his father's theft of the package and confronts him with the truth.

30.o: The people of the neighborhood try to help Omar to pay off the debt, and Omar sells all his property. Khaled dies in the war. El Makhraz feels lonely because people snub him for stealing the package.

31.o: Umm Sadiq offers to wed Omar to Bahia, his brother Khaled's widow, to raise his brother's children, but he refuses. El Makhraz returns the money to Omar. It turns out that Khaled is alive and that Saadia is pregnant, much to Omar's joy.

1.t: The Most Pointless Thing in the World
1.o: تجد مسؤولة العلاقات العامّة البارعة "هان بيول أوه" نفسها في مواجهة موقف طارئ حين يعود العميل الأكبر والأكثر إزعاجًا لديها بفضيحة مدوّية.

2.o: يشكّل وجود "تاي سونغ غونغ" إزعاجًا لدى "هان بيول" في العمل. وبعدما ترتكب موظّفة جديدة خطأً ما، تخرج قصّة من ماضي "هان بيول" إلى العلن.

3.o: تنتشر صورة مسرّبة فتسبّب بلبلة، وتتقرّب "هو يونغ بارك" من ممثل صاعد متردّد. أمّا "هان بيول" و"تاي سونغ"، فيخوضان غمار استبيانات عن التوتّر والإجهاد.

1.o: Li Wei of Ji Plains, Hao Jia of Yan Plains and Princess Shangguan Jing of Dan Plains are gathered in Xin Plains for the marriage selection. Meanwhile, the young masters are discussing these ladies except for Yin Zheng, the Sixth Young Master. Yin Zheng goes to the kitchen and finds Li Wei stealing his food. Suddenly, his old illness acts up, and Li Wei carries him out of the kitchen.

2.o: Li Wei just wants to fail the selection and go home. But she is chosen by Sixth Young Master. His Majesty doesn't know how to deal with her from her performance. In the end, Yin Zheng offers to marry her instead. His Majesty is thankful and promises to find a good first wife for him later. Shangguan Jing and Hao Jia are facing trouble with their married life too. Li Wei misunderstands that Yin Zheng has only half a month left to live. She does her best to take care of Yin Zheng. Her action confuses him until he sees her letters to her family.

3.o: Yin Zheng tops the exam but goes home to see Li Wei mourning in sackcloth. Seeing Yin Zheng in the pink of health, Li Wei realizes that she misunderstood it and is very devastated. Xin Plains Madam arranges a make-up wedding for them after knowing Yin Zheng has recovered. Li Wei tries every possible way to avoid it. Third Young Master is impeached for not attending the court for a long time. Xin Plains Master does not want to make a fuss and asks his brothers to get him back. But no one is willing to do the job, so Yin Zheng takes on the troublesome task and brings Li Wei to visit the Third Yo

4.o: Li Wei and Yin Zheng persuade the Third Young Master to return to the palace. Yin Zheng finally recognized Li Wei's ability. He requested for Li Wei's cooperation to enter the Imperial Court. Li Wei, Shangguan Jing, and Hao Jia became friends with Yuan Si Si after an event at the Hall of Education. When they heard that Li Wei was forced to eat bland food, they prepared their hometown dishes for her. Li Wei realized that she needed to win over Chef Liu Bao Quan. Finally, after some effort, Li Wei was able to obtain the right to order dishes.

5.o: Li Wei and Shangguan Jing are punished because they contradicted Madam Yan, even Yin Zheng is called to witness it. When Yin Zheng finds out about the whole incident, he doesn't blame Li Wei, he brings her back and treats her wound for her. Li Wei is touched and decides to help him with his stomach issue. Dan Plains is suffering from a flash flood. Yin Zheng does his best to come up with a solution. In the end, he's recognized by His Majesty. He is then asked to organize the Mid-Autumn Palace Banquet.

6.o: During the Mid-Autumn Festival banquet, Li Wei and Yin Zheng impressed Xin Plains' Master. Xin Plains' Master wanted to reward his son, but Yin Zheng asked that Li Wei be allowed to meet her family. The Mid-Autumn Festival is actually also Yin Zheng's birthday but everybody was busy spending time with their family and forgot about Yin Zheng's birthday.

7.o: When they arrived in Dan Plains, Dan Plains' Master, Shangguan Yan, was angry at Yin Qi, so she made things difficult for him and evaluated him for expected husband's behavior. Yin Qi passed the tests and met Shangguan Jing. There, he understood that the lady was supposed to live a free life, but to maintain the hundred-year alliance between Dan and Xin Plains, she gave up that life and chose to live in a palace.

8.o: Due to the situation, Yin Zheng, who's best at hiding his feelings, ends up expressing his fondness for Li Wei in public. Dan Plains Master stopped putting them on the spot after that. She says that she'll allow Shangguan Jing, her younger sister, to return to Xin Plains with Qi as long as he can make her happy again.

9.o: Yin Zheng wants to gather funds to repay Xin Plains' debt. He realizes there were debts of former officials from the late Master's era. So, he works with Li Wei to acquire the help of Third Young Master who is well-versed in the business world.

10.o: Together with Third Young Master, Yin Zheng sends the collected fund to Jin Plains and finally convinces Jin Plains Master to accept the repayment in installments. The mission is successfully completed and Yin Zheng finally gets the opportunity to go to the court, which means he can start his own mansion. Yin Zheng takes this opportunity to ask Xin Plains Master to make Li Wei his legitimate wife, but Xin Plain Master slurs over it.

11.o: Yin Zheng feels nervous about attending court for the first time. Li Wei encourages him and promises to stay if she waits at home for him. Yin Zheng has no chance of speaking in court and has to remain silent under Yin Song's pressure.

12.o: On the night of the wedding, before Yin Zheng talks to Yuan Ying, she has already changed out of her wedding dress and she tells Yin Zheng bluntly that their marriage is a business deal between the plains masters.

13.o: Although Yuan Ying is strict, Li Wei admires her. She understands that Yuan Ying did so for her own good. She even persuades Song Wu, who treats Yuan Ying as her imaginary rival to stop being mean to her. She points out that Yuan Ying isn't someone who will be trapped in the mansion.

14.o: Yin Qi suddenly feels dizzy and starts to vomit. He seems to suffer from food poisoning. After looking at the menu, Li Wei realizes the amaranth, which replaces the lettuce, has caused food poisoning because it is consumed with turtle soup. Yuan Ying blames herself while Li Wei consoles her. She suggests Yuan Ying share the burden with her.

15.o: Yuan Ying has always been tiring herself out. She's even making arrangements in the middle of the night, calculating how to allocate the mansion's expenses and personnel. She's stressed out, and she falls sick because of it. Li Wei almost starts a clash with the government soldiers as she's worried for Yuan Ying's health.

16.o: It's time for another political marriage between Xin Plains and Mo Plains. According to custom, the princess of Xin Plains has to be married to Mo Plains. Plains Madam and Yin Song are not willing to marry Princess Shu Yu. They suggest granting Madam He's foster daughter, Song Wu, the title of princess and marrying her to Mo Plains.

17.o: Li Wei, Yin Zheng, and Yuan Ying work together to host a meeting with the envoys of Mo Plains and Mo Plains Madam. They use the lotus plumule tea to represent the suffering of the separation between a daughter and her mother. They express their willingness to give Mo Plains a hand. They also promise to personally depart to Mo Plains to help them out locally with their agriculture issues.

18.o: After finishing the tasks at hand, Li Wei suggested that since they were in Mo Plains, they should pay her grandfather a visit. Yin Zheng, the Fifth Young Master, and the Third Young Master all breathed a sigh of relief – they had not been sober since they came to Mo Plains, and they needed not to drink at Li Wei’s grandfather’s house

19.o: Song Wu realizes that Song Wu is the person she wants to spend her life with. In order to pursue Song Wu, Song Wu draws on Li Wei's parents' tactics back then.

20.o: Yin Zheng's new position requires him to organize the Envoy Banquet to treat his subordinates and envoys. Li Wei does her best to organize the banquet but the rules don't allow the concubine to attend the banquet.

21.o: Li Wei is busy preparing for the opening of their new restaurant. Yin Zheng helps her out in secret. He even sends a note that contains his suggestions to Li Wei in secret.

22.o: Third Young Master opens a rip-off of Nine Plains Gourmet Restaurant to compete against the women. He tries to steal their staff by offering high salaries. He also tries to steal their customers by starting a price war. However, they are prepared for the situation.

23.o: The restaurant is finally back to normal operation, and the sisters are all working hard for their careers. Under Yuan Ying's guidance, Li Wei's leadership skills have improved gradually. She even accepts Song Wu as an apprentice.

24.o: Yin Zheng and Li Wei asked for Madam He's help and took Great Madam to visit Hao Jia in Yin Song's mansion. Under Yin Song's coercion, Hao Jia had to pretend to be fine. After Li Wei and others left, Hao Jia had a complete showdown with Yin Song, but received even greater reprimand and humiliation. Hao Jia was completely desperate and chose to end her life.

25.o: Yin Zheng and Li Wei asked for Madam He's help and took Great Madam to visit Hao Jia in Yin Song's mansion. Under Yin Song's coercion, Hao Jia had to pretend to be fine. After Li Wei and others left, Hao Jia had a complete showdown with Yin Song, but received even greater reprimand and humiliation. Hao Jia was completely desperate and chose to end her life.

26.o: Madam He summons Li Wei to talk to her. Li Wei heard that Madam He had gone through the same situation. She consoles Madam He and asks her not to blame herself anymore. She asks Yin Zheng to be understanding toward Madam He and consoles him for all the suffering that he went through.

27.o: When Yin Zheng takes Yin Qi out on a mission, he learns about the impact of the road closure at the border between Dan Plains and Dai Plains on the local merchants and decides to let the people pass before reporting it. That is exactly what Yin Song wants and therefore, he's accused of overreaching his authority. As soon as Yin Zheng and Yin Qi return to Xin Plains, they are held accountable by the Xin Plains Master.

28.o: Yin Qi and Shangguan Jing have to move out of the mansion after being demoted. The restaurant is forced to close, so Shangguan Jing has to sell her most valuable weapons. The two of them have to live in such straitened circumstances for the first time. Yin Qi is not concerned on the surface, but in fact, he knows it and feels very uncomfortable, not wanting Shangguan Jing to suffer with him.

29.o: Yin Zheng visits Yin Song when his mansion is being cleared out. They advise each other. When Yin Zheng leaves, someone brings in poisonous wine granted by Xin Plains Master. Yin Song loses all his hope and drinks it. Yin Zheng feels something is wrong.

30.o: The Women's Chamber of Commerce is shut down. So, Hao Jia dresses up like a man to sell homemade make-up and fragrances that she's good at. Her business is a hit and she can now make a living for herself. Zhao Fang Ru has decided to leave Yin Song too. She's going back to Dai Plains to inherit her family's mining business and start a new life. At the prison, Hao Jia and Zhao Fang Ru work together to make Yin Song sign the divorce paper.

31.o: Xin Plains Master wasn't willing to let Yin Zheng divorce Yuan Ying. However, Yin Zheng uses the jade pendant he finds when he saves Yin Song and exchanges it for Yuan Ying's freedom.

32.o: Li Wei, Yin Zheng, and Yuan Ying analyzed why Jin Plains Master was stubborn. Li Wei finally realized that Jin Plains Master was not a person who only considered his own interests. The reason for his objection is that he was worried that his daughter and wife would be lonely for the rest of their lives. After saying out her thoughts loud and courageously, Jin Plains Master pondered for a long time, but still refused to admit it.

33.o: Yin Qi found Shangguan Jing, who was trying to travel the world, and he followed her. Shangguan Jing discovered him long ago. She wishes to convince him to head back. Yin Qi says that he's the Living Map of the Nine Plains and wants to be Shangguan's guide.

34.o: Madam He has to leave the palace. So, she entrusts Eleventh Young Master to Yin Zheng and Li Wei. He wants bedtime stories at night and he's picky about his food. He even asks a lot of sensitive questions. Yin Zheng and Li Wei can't take care of him and send him to school to be taught by a tutor. However, the naughty young master causes huge trouble at school.

35.o: A cold surge hits the border between Xin and Cang Plains. Xin Plains Master sends Yin Zheng and Fourth Young Master for disaster relief as a test of their abilities. Fourth Young Master goes to the bigger town, Wuxiang, while Yin Zheng chooses to go to the more remote town, Canghe. The town is bitterly cold, and Yin Zheng physically researches and distributes relief supplies, but he neglects his own health and unfortunately catches a cold. Yet, he still holds on to help the local people solve their problems.

36.o: Yin Zheng's illness gets worse after being dragged on for a long time and he faints. Fourth Young Master returns to Xin Plains as if nothing has happened but he hides Yin Zheng's situation from Xin Plains Master.

37.o: Xin Plains Master fell sick due to over-exhaustion. As his condition worsens, he doesn't allow people to visit him. Yin Qi rushes back to Xin Plains after hearing the news. Yin Qi is heartbroken when he saw his father being tortured by sickness. He decides to stay and take care of him.

38.o: Yin Zheng and Li Wei arrive in Ji Plains. Li Wen Bi doesn't want his daughter to stay in Xin Plains and objects to the marriage. He gives Yin Zheng many trials.

39.o: Li Wei helps Madam He to manage the Inner Court. After discussing it with her sisters, she decides to revise the syllables of the Hall of Education. The teacher in charge isn't willing to accept the change. They express their stand that people shouldn't force one's will onto another.

40.o: It's the Mid-Autumn Festival again. Li Wei and the others are secretly planning for Yin Zheng's birthday to give him a surprise. Everyone pretends to forget Yin Zheng's birthday, and he's used to everyone forgetting his birthday. So, he doesn't bring it up. When everyone is having fun, Yin Zheng feels depressed that Li Wei is absent because of the restaurant. But Li Wei shows up with the longevity noodles that she personally makes as a surprise for him.

2.o: "سام" يحثّ "أوتو" على الحفاظ على هدوئه، إذ بدأ الركاب يشكّون في وجود مشكلة ما. تُهرع رئيسة الشرطة "وينتر" لاتخاذ رد فعل.

3.o: تندفع شرطة "برلين" لاحتواء الموقف. "سام" يضغط على "وينتر" للاستجابة لمطالبه. "مارشا" تكتشف أنها مراقبة.

4.o: على إثر تحوّل مفاجئ في الأحداث، يُجبر "سام" على تقديم مبادرة لإثبات حسن نواياه. في "لندن"، يتصل "دانيل" بصديقة لمساعدته على فهم ما يحدث في "برلين".

5.o: بدأ الغضب والإحباط يتأججان وسط الركاب بالتزامن مع استيعاب "سام" حقيقة مرعبة.

7.o: يغامر "سام" بحيلة خطرة أملاً في التفوق على الشرطة بذكائه. متسلّحةً بمعلومات جديدة، تحاول "أوليفيا" التأثير في قرار "وينتر" القادم.

8.o: مع اقتراب عملية التسليم، "سام" مستعد للمخاطرة بحياته لإنقاذ "مارشا" وكشف الحقيقة.

18.o: Emotions are running high in the Walker family when Nora and Saul find out their mother, Ida, has passed away.

22.o: As Sarah and Luc’s nuptials approach, plans go horribly awry and the Walkers learn several surprising lessons about the real meaning of family, on the Series Finale of “Brothers & Sisters”.
